# Matheo Flores — Full-Stack Web Developer

> Matheo Flores is a full-stack web developer based in Quito, Ecuador,
> working remotely with clients worldwide. He designs, builds and launches
> complete websites for businesses that want to look professional, appear
> on Google and turn visits into customers.

## What he does

- Complete websites end to end: domain, design, code, SEO and launch
- Full-stack development: frontend, backend, database and deployment
- Site rebuilds and redesigns for businesses with outdated websites
- Stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Supabase, Tailwind CSS

## Availability

- Based in Quito, Ecuador (GMT-5)
- Works remotely with clients globally (Spanish and English)
